title: field-sampler-onboarding-brief-aug05-2027
content:
Field Sampler — onboarding + weekly capture (week of 2027-08-05)

Purpose: quick consumable notes from the applied-ml spike/standup for the field-sampler onboarding track. Focus areas: low-bit quantization probes, eval regression sniff-tests, and model onboarding checklist for the new 13B variant. Not a formal PRD; rough capture for sync and follow-ups.

Attendees: Maya T. (owner), Ethan P., Priya N., Carlos R., Jing W. (remote join), SRE: Anika S.

Highlights / TL;DR:
- Initial 4-bit PTQ sweep on 13B-new shows latency savings ~27% median, perf drop limited to 2–3% on L1 task set (QA/short-completion).
- Two failing eval cases surfaced for chain-of-thought style prompts — appears tied to attention kernel fallback on seq>2048.
- KV-prefetch microbatch experiment promising: cold-start token latency down ~18% when using prefix caching heuristics.
- Onboarding checklist mostly complete; key outstanding: KMS integration validation + canary rollback policy write-up.

Agenda recap from standup (2027-08-05):
1) Quant sweep status (Ethan)
2) Evals triage for regression incidents (Priya)
3) Serving/runtime notes: attention kernel mismatch (Carlos)
4) Ops: dedicated canary config and KMS checks (Anika)
5) Next actions and owners

1) Quant sweep notes (Ethan)
- Experiments ran on div-ptq pipeline (repo PR#4982). Sweep summary: per-layer symmetric 4-bit with round-to-nearest, and mixed 3/4-bit hybrid for attention-only layers.
- Result snapshot (median over 5 seeds):
  - baseline fp16 median latency: 38.2ms
  - 4-bit PTQ median latency: 28.0ms
  - mixed 3/4 median latency: 25.6ms
  - eval delta (L1 QA accuracy): baseline 85.4% -> 4-bit 83.1% (2.3pt drop), mixed 83.6% (1.8pt drop)
- Notes: accuracy drop concentrated on numeric parsing prompts and some tokenization edge cases. Probable cause: late-layer scale quant noise.
- Action items: add per-layer clipping table to the sweep artifacts (Ethan), test per-head quant clamping for last 6 layers (Ethan + Jing), open issue to add tokenizer-stress unit tests (Maya)

2) Evals triage (Priya)
- Two reproducible regression clusters identified: chain-of-thought prompts with long contexts, and multi-hop retrieval summaries.
- Root cause hypothesis: attention kernel fallback for long sequences uses fallback op that changes floating rounding semantics under quant path. Proof-of-concept: forcing kernel A (optimized) removes regression but increases peak GPU memory by ~6%.
- Temporary mitigation: implement eval gating to route sensitive evals to fp16 variant. Longer term: collaborate with runtime team to harmonize fallback kernels.
- Logged tickets: JIRA-3221 (eval triage), JIRA-3299 (kernel fallback analysis)

3) Serving/runtime notes (Carlos)
- Kernel selector currently picks based on sequence length thresholds that are conservative. For mixed-precision quant variants, thresholds might be too low -> triggers fallback.
- Suggested tweak: dynamic thresholding based on observed memory headroom per node + model variant tag. This requires minor changes in routing config and an SLO conversation.
- Observability: add a label in traces when fallback kernel engaged; spike shows 0.7% of requests used fallback in last 24h but these map to 6 of top 10 regression samples.
- Action: Carlos to draft runtime change RFC and add debug tracing flag for next week.

4) Ops & onboarding checklist (Anika / Maya)
- Onboarding checklist status:
  - artifact build: done
  - bench suite: done (bench-quant-suite v2)
  - canary config: draft (needs rollback policy)
  - KMS + key rotation tests: pending (blocked on infra ticket)
  - compliance notes for private deploy: drafted
- Canary rollback policy sketch: keep N=50 sample set, staggered ramp (1%, 5%, 20%, full), auto-fallback to pinned fp16 replica on >3% eval degradation over 10m window. Need input from SRE and Product.
- Action: Anika to open infra ticket for KMS service account and run key-rotation dry run (target: 2027-08-11). Maya to write canary rollback doc (first draft by 2027-08-09).

5) KV-prefetch microbatch experiment (Priya / Ethan)
- Motivation: reduce cold-start tokens for conversational workloads by prefetching common prefixes into KV cache and serving small microbatches.
- Experiment config: warm cache with top-500 prefix tokens histogram, microbatch size 4, batching window 10ms.
- Results: tail P95 token latency improved from 120ms -> 98ms; median up ~18% reduction for cold cold-starts. Cost impact: +3% GPU mem use, but throughput improved for concurrency spikes.
- Open question: how to safely evict prefetched prefixes for privacy-sensitive sessions? Proposal: per-customer namespace + TTL of 2m for ephemeral workloads. Need privacy check with security team.

Open questions / blockers:
- KMS access for onboarding pipeline blocked by infra IAM (Anika tracking).
- Attention kernel numerical discrepancy when fallback triggers: need deeper fp rounding trace (Carlos + runtime).
- Tokenization edge cases that amplify quant noise: create fuzz-bed for tokenizer combos (Maya + Priya).

Quick TODO list (owners):
- Ethan: add per-layer clipping table to sweep artifacts, run per-head clamping tests (due 2027-08-09)
- Jing: reproduce regression on seq>2048 and capture kernel trace (due 2027-08-08)
- Carlos: draft runtime RFC + add fallback-tracing label (draft due 2027-08-10)
- Anika: open infra ticket for KMS service account + run rotation dry-run (target 2027-08-11)
- Maya: write canary rollback doc and tokenizer fuzz-bed proposal (drafts due 2027-08-09)

Lightweight experiment log (for reproducibility):
- sweep-id: field-sample-aug05-4bit-v2
- env: dev-cluster-e6 (4xA100), batch=1, seq=1024 unless specified
- eval set: L1-qa-v2 (1k q), CoT-sim (200 prompts), retrieval-smoke (300 docs)
- artifacts: s3://redwood-experiments/field-sampler/field-sample-aug05-4bit-v2/{metrics.csv,per-layer.json,seed-logs.tar.gz}

Notes on reproducibility: always include tokenizer version and BPE merges. We saw a 0.6pt delta when comparing tokenizers v2.1 -> v2.2 on the numeric parsing subset.

Next sync: quick standup Tuesday 2027-08-10 (10:30am PT) to triage kernel traces + review canary doc. If priority emerges, do ad-hoc deep-dive.

Misc scraps / brainstorming (informal)
- Idea: small dynamic quant head that switches modes based on prefix entropy estimate; speculative but potentially reduces numeric noise.
- Persona testing: ask Solutions Eng to run a small on-customer prompt set (anonymized) to validate regressions in realistic traffic.
- Consider adding a "regression-smoke" hook in Redwood Console that can run a 30-min canary eval on rollout.

End of capture.
